cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
cp classic_screen.py backup_rot/classic_screen_v1.py; cp classic_pos_html.py backup_rot/classic_pos_html_v1.py
for f in classic_screen.py classic_pos_html.py; do
  curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f" -o /tmp/new_$f || { echo FETCH_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
  python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_$f',encoding='utf-8').read())" || { echo PARSE_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
done
for f in classic_screen.py classic_pos_html.py; do cp /tmp/new_$f $f; done; chown tbot:tbot classic_*.py
systemctl restart classicbot
T0=$(date +%s)
for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 3; L=$(curl -s -m 10 localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('1' if d.get('loading') else '0')" 2>/dev/null); [ "$L" = "0" ] && break; done
echo готово_через_после_перезапуска=$(( $(date +%s)-T0 ))с
curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('load',d['load']);print({k:(d['accounts'][k]['account']['equity'],d['accounts'][k]['account']['taken']) for k in ('me','bot','both')})"
curl -s -X POST localhost:8091/api/screen > /dev/null
for i in $(seq 1 24); do sleep 5; B=$(curl -s localhost:8091/api/screen | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('1' if d['busy'] else '0')"); [ "$B" = "0" ] && break; done
curl -s localhost:8091/api/screen | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin);x=d['data']
print('err',d['err'],'типичная',x['typical'],'лучшие',x['median'])
print('текущие:',[(c['sym'],c['rng14']) for c in x['cur']])
print('замена:',[(c['sym'],c['why']) for c in x['replace']])"
journalctl -u classicbot --since '3 min ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -c Traceback
